Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly proposed treating Universal Music Group (the distributor) as the parent company of Apple Records when Britannica’s wording wasn’t explicit. This conflated distribution with ownership and would have produced the wrong answer; the correct parent is Apple Corps Ltd.
